title: 第7章 小时候的事第8章 舟崖秘境
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
这也太贵了吧！
还好，不是自己掏的灵石。
花乾愣怔后松了口气，又突然反应过来，极品灵石是掌门令出的，那不就也是自己的东西。
啊！
我的灵石！
见师叔祖不能动了，冷魔艳又活泼起来了，她看着一脸沮丧的花乾说道：“师姐，一会谈判的时候，你可别给我们丢脸哦。”
花乾侧头瞧着她，啧了一声，“我丢脸那也是掌门，你就算能不丢脸，你也去不了。”
“你们三人一会把师叔祖抬着过去，给我们压压阵。”她边说边打开师叔祖的后背，拿出那块失去了灵气，但依旧晶莹剔透的极品灵石，换了块下品的进去。
萧时乐见状问道：“师姐，下品灵石能让师叔祖恢复战力？”
他平日最喜欢看书，是目前守灵门最博学的一位，灵石的品阶一点也不陌生，那块刚换下来的就是极品灵石。
这灵石差距也太大了，真能替代吗？
花乾起身说道：“要什么战力，把师叔祖抬过去，关键时候他只要抬个头，就能把那群修士吓得屁滚尿流。”
这时，师叔祖咔嚓一声，真抬头瞅向她，然后便把那块下品灵石消耗光了。
“我的老祖宗啊，你别乱动好不好，家里现在什么光景，你老天天坐在敬祖殿里又不是不知道，下品灵石也用一块少一块，全派已经负债累累，就别再给我添负担了。”花乾嚎啕起来，只得又换了块灵石。
这样好像不是办法，她转头看向了冷魔艳，“小师妹，你不是魔头夺舍转世吗？把你藏起来的洞府拿一个出来，我们去拿点灵石法宝来救救急。”
“不白用你的，等师父回来后加倍还你。”
冷魔艳气愤地喊道：“我不是魔头！哪来的洞府。”
“真不是？”花乾皱眉问道。
冷魔艳咬牙切齿地说：“真的不是。”
花乾失望极了，“怎么就不是呢，可恶。”

一旁的萧时乐看不下去了，“师姐，还是先想想一会和那些债主谈的时候，要说些什么吧。”
“说的也是，去谈的话必须要先发制人，才能处于不败之地。”花乾皱眉思索起来，目光打量着门派此时的战力。
一个吞金兽般的独臂师叔祖，三个炼气期的小屁孩。
怎么才能让债主的气焰嚣张不起来呢？
突然，她灵光一闪有了想法。
“我有好办法了，你们听我的，保管叫债主们唯唯诺诺不敢和我们叫嚣。”花乾一拍手喊道。
萧时乐和冷魔艳很质疑，这段时间的接触下来，他们已经知道这位掌门师姐有多讨嫌，甚至有怀疑过她这二十几年没在门内，不是去游历，而是被逐出师门了。
她不会是想把师弟师妹拿去抵债吧？
花乾斜瞅着他俩问道：“干嘛？不然我们搬走，把门派留给他们还债。”
“咔嚓。”
师叔祖抬头看向她，灵石又少了一块。
“……”花乾盯着它沉默了一会，做出了决定，“还是不带师叔祖过去了，省得它总是动来动去，商议结束后我们门派就一块灵石也没了。”
“不过在这之前，我们要换一身衣物，先从外观上威慑住那些债主。”她狠狠说道。
看着师姐走进殿中换衣物，萧时乐不知道她要打扮成什么样，但最好正常一些，千万不要奇奇怪怪啊。

content_en:
This is too expensive!
Fortunately, I didn't pay for the spiritual stone myself.
Hua Gan was stunned for a moment and then breathed a sigh of relief. Then he suddenly realized that the top-quality spiritual stone was ordered by the leader, so it was also his own.
ah!
My spiritual stone!
Seeing that her uncle couldn't move, Leng Moyan became lively again. She looked at Huagan who looked depressed and said, "Senior sister, please don't embarrass us during the negotiation."
Huagan turned his head to look at her and tutted, "If I am embarrassed, it will be the leader. Even if you can avoid being embarrassed, you can't go."
"The three of you will carry my uncle over in a moment and help us suppress the formation." She said as she opened his back, took out the top-grade spiritual stone that had lost its spiritual energy but was still crystal clear, and replaced it with a lower-grade one.
Seeing this, Xiao Shile asked, "Senior sister, can a low-grade spiritual stone restore my uncle's fighting strength?"
He likes to read the most on weekdays, and is currently the most knowledgeable person in the Soul Watching Sect. The grade of spiritual stones is not unfamiliar at all, and the one he just replaced is a top-grade spiritual stone.
The gap between these spiritual stones is too big, can they really be replaced?
Hua Gan stood up and said, "What kind of fighting power do you need? Just carry my uncle over. At the critical moment, he can scare the shit out of those monks just by raising his head."
At this time, Master Shishu made a click, looked up at her, and then consumed all the low-grade spiritual stone.
"My ancestor, please don't move around. What's going on at home now? You sit in the Ancestor Respecting Hall every day and you don't know. Even low-grade spiritual stones need one less. The whole sect is already heavily in debt, so don't burden me anymore." Huagan started to wail and had to change another spiritual stone.
This didn't seem to be the solution, so she turned to look at Leng Moyan, "Little junior sister, aren't you the reincarnation of a devil? Take one out of the cave where you are hiding, and let's get some spiritual stones and magic weapons to save the day."
"If you don't use it in vain, I will return it to you twice as much when Master comes back."
Leng Moyan shouted angrily: "I'm not a devil! Where did the cave come from?"
"Really?" Hua Gan asked with a frown.
Leng Moyan gritted her teeth and said, "It's really not."
Huagan was extremely disappointed, "Why not, damn it."
Xiao Shile on the side couldn't stand it anymore, "Senior sister, let's think about what to say when we talk to those creditors first."
"It's true. If you go to talk, you must strike first to be in an invincible position." Hua Gan frowned and thought, looking at the sect's combat power at this time.
A one-armed master uncle who looked like a gold-eating beast, and three little brats in the Qi refining stage.
How can we prevent creditors from becoming arrogant?
Suddenly, she had an idea.
"I have a good idea. You listen to me. The creditors are obedient and dare not make noises with us." Hua Gan clapped his hands and shouted.
Xiao Shile and Leng Moyan were very suspicious. After their contact over this period of time, they already knew how annoying the head senior sister was. They even suspected that she had not been in the sect for more than 20 years. Instead of traveling, she was expelled from the sect.
Doesn't she want to use her junior brothers and sisters to pay off their debts?
Huagan looked at them sideways and asked, "What are you doing? Otherwise, we move away and leave the sect to them to pay off their debts."
"Click."
Uncle Master raised his head and looked at her. Another piece of spiritual stone was missing.
"..." Hua Gan stared at it in silence for a while and then made a decision, "It's better to go there without my uncle, so as not to keep it moving around. After the discussion is over, our sect will not have a single spiritual stone."
"But before that, we need to change our clothes to deter those creditors with our appearance." She said fiercely.
Watching the senior sister enter the palace to change clothes, Xiao Shile didn't know how she was going to dress up, but it was best to be normal and not be weird.
